orbit_labels.reason: Both fields describe orbit-ephemeris provenance, but the values disagree. Product Format Document 1.2.1 section 2.2.4 maps filename code N to NOE. The observed HDF5 orbitType value is MOE. The original values are unchanged and still require verification against the product metadata and provider guidance.
